After automatically installing a new kernel, Ubuntu 24.04 has lost the ethernet network. This frustrating issue occurred for me a second time, so I'm documenting the solution here to help others facing the same problem. Here are the commands that restored my network connectivity. # Update package lists and upgrade system sudo apt update sudo apt upgrade
